name: Glow Neon
desc: Montserrat Black, active word cyan with neon glow. sohaib's pick — default.

name: Hormozi Pop
desc: Anton ALL-CAPS, active word pops 80→112→100% and turns yellow.

name: Hype
desc: Anton ALL-CAPS, active word pops and turns RED — PeakCut's 'CHOPPER UH' look, sohaib's benchmark.

name: Karaoke Sweep
desc: Montserrat ExtraBold, accent colour sweeps left-to-right through the active word.
source: aman ClipKaro karaoke (\kf sweep) + our V2 karaoke

name: Pop
desc: Per-word scale bounce 80→112→100%, white — the bounce without the colour pop.

name: Fade Up
desc: Words fade in and slide up as they are spoken.

name: Highlighter Box
desc: Opaque yellow highlighter box behind the active word, black text.

name: Pulse
desc: Active word swells to 122% then settles — a heartbeat on every word.

name: Boxed
desc: Opaque dark box behind the whole caption line, active word in blue.

name: Cinematic
desc: Smaller elegant lowercase text, faint glow, dark backing plate — for documentaries.

name: Classic
desc: Simple clean white text, thin outline, no animation — interviews.

name: Minimal
desc: Fade-in; hype keywords light up in yellow, the rest stays white.

name: Bold
desc: Extra-large heavy text, thick outline — shouts the loudest moments.

name: Comic
desc: Bangers comic font, playful tilt — fun moments, gaming bants.

name: Typewriter
desc: Letters appear one by one as they are spoken.

name: Pill
desc: Active word inside a white pill, black text — clean and readable.

name: Bounce
desc: Active word bounces with a spring and turns cyan — the Beasty/Mozi look.

name: Rawani
desc: A glowing teal underline extends beneath the words as speech continues.

name: Lafz
desc: One bold outlined word at a time, popping in as it is spoken.

name: Aks
desc: Oversized words; the spoken word is inverted — black text on a white box.

name: Lakeer
desc: White text with a crisp blue underline on the active word only.

name: Ali Abdaal
desc: White rounded card; gray words turn black as they are spoken.

name: Shamani
desc: Glowing yellow phrases, gentle floating wave, pop-and-fade entrance.

name: Saaf
desc: Clean bold white; each spoken word slides up into place.

name: Lehar
desc: A violet pill fills left-to-right as the words are spoken.
